<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aryl halide and forms a secondary amine, which corresponds to the S_NAr transformation needed for the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
